Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 0  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made an initial error in interpreting the task by introducing unnecessary ambiguity. The task specifically mentions "Tomskoye, Amur Oblast" and "Pleshkovo" without indicating multiple possible locations for "Pleshkovo." Despite this, the Planner assumed ambiguity and directed WebSurfer to search for multiple possible Pleshkovo locations globally, leading to the discovery of "Pleshkovo" in both Russia and Poland. This assumption diverted the task from its straightforward verification of whether Tomskoye (explicitly in Amur Oblast) and Pleshkovo (without any additional qualifier) belong to the same country. This unwarranted complexity resulted in unnecessary confusion and redundant searches in later steps. This was an avoidable error stemming from overcomplication of the task at the very outset.
